Commentary.Commentary: Right! A washout in the first game. Then England's superb win in the run chase. And then Pakistan holding on their nerves in the final one to force 1-1 in this 3-match T20I series. That's all we have got from this series and Pakistan's tour to England. Pakistan go home with a win in the bag while England will be disappointed with their performance today. England's summer is not done yet as they face Australia in a 3 T20I series starting from 4th September at 1800 local (1700 GMT). Until then, cheers.

Pakistan skipper, Babar Azam, says that it was an entertaining game. Feels that the batters put on a total which they wanted to post. Says that they started well with the ball as well but Moeen did well to push them back. On the chatter in the last over, Babar says that the talk was to bowl the wide yorkers in the over and feels apart from the fifth ball which was a slower short one, Rauf delivered with the ball. Praises and thanks ECB for putting up an amazing tour and looking after the players.

England skipper, Eoin Morgan, says that their bowlers did really well to stop Pakistan to 190 as the boundary on the one side was very short. Feels that bowlers have been a bit rusty as things were under lockdown and it is tough to get going straightaway but feels with Australia series, they will get a lot better. Praises Banton for his performance. On Moeen's innings, Morgan says he is happy to see him in the runs and tells he is really amazing and elegant when he scores.

MOHAMMED HAFEEZ IS NAMED PLAYER OF THE SERIES AND PLAYER OF THE MAN OF THE MATCH AWARD! Tells that he is really happy to grab the awards and perform for the team when they needed him. Feels Haider just expressed himself out in the middle and tells he just tried to back him every time they spoke in the middle. Praises the management for their support in the past two months. On his chances of making to the T20 World Cup, Hafeez says he is taking one game at a time and is happy to perform for the team.

Earlier in the game, England invited Pakistan to bat first after winning the toss. While the hosts started well, Haider Ali, the debutant along with experienced and in-form Mohammad Hafeez added 100 to take Pakistan towards a good total. Haider got out after scoring a half ton but Hafeez remained unbeaten on 86 and helped Pakistan get to 190. The bowling from England wasn't up to the mark as only Jordan ended up with decent figures and others were pummelled for a total which eventually ended up being little too far from the reach of England batters.

Pakistan started really well with Afridi striking in the very first over. Malan was removed by Imad while a brilliance in the field from skipper Babar meant Pakistan were on top early on. Rauf trapped Banton in front of the stumps soon to give Pakistan more control in the game. However, they couldn't go past the Billings-Moeen stand which added 50-plus to keep the Pakistani bowlers at bay for a while. Shadab was smoked for 3 sixes in his final over of the game and that put more pressure on Pakistan. However, Riaz and Afridi pulled their socks up and put a fine bowling performance towards the end to help Pakistan seal the game. Wahab's penultimate over which went for just 3 meant England were left with a little too more to score in the final over.

England started poorly with the bat as they lost Bairstow in the first over who failed to open his account. Malan couldn't do much either as he fell in the 4th over of the game. Banton though looked brilliant once again as he smashed a few very good shots. However, confusion between him and skipper Morgan saw the latter depart to the pavilion which pushed England further back in the game. Banton fell for 46 soon after to leave England reeling in the run chase. However, Billings and Ali combined for a fine 50-plus partnership and took England a bit closer. However, Billings fell for 26 but Ali didn't. He smashed 3 sixes in the 16th over of the chase to bring England right back in the game. He got out in the penultimate over and England eventually ended up on the wrong side.

Wow! What a game of cricket! We never knew which side it will end and it is Pakistan who keep their nerves in the end to win this game and end the series with 1-1. Fine comeback by the Pakistani pacers in this game to force this result. Moeen Ali was looking threatening to take the game away but the experience of Wahab Riaz in the penultimate over changed the game in favor of Pakistan. There was some nerves after the second last ball was smoked for half a dozen but in the end all is well for Rauf, Azam and Pakistan.
Terrific delivery! Just what he needed to bowl the previous delivery! Very full delivery outside off, Curran fails to dig it out. PAKISTAN WIN BY 5 RUNS.

SIX! There's one of them! What a time to hit that shot! Babar Azam is not happy as this was a poor delivery! Should have bowled full! Short ball outside off, Curran powers it over deep cover for a biggie.
Good length ball on off, Rashid scoops it to fine leg for a single. 12 needed from 2 balls. 2 sixes needed.
Full delivery on middle, Rashid flicks it to deep mid-wicket and picks up a couple. England need a boundary.
Excellent delivery! Very full delivery on middle, Curran cannot do much as he digs it out towards long off. Only a single.
Slower ball outside off, Rashid looks to heave it to the off side but misses. Curran calls for the single. Sarfaraz has a shy at the stumps but misses.
Haris Rauf will bowl the final over.
Good length ball on middle, Curran looks to play the scoop but fails to do so. 17 more needed.
Adil Rashid makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! The big wicket falls and Pakistan are on top now! End of an excellent innings from Moeen Ali but he cannot stay there to take his side home. Short ball on middle, Ali looks to pull but it takes the top edge and it goes towards the bowler who makes no mistake. England need something special now.
Short ball outside off, Ali looks to play the upper cut but misses. Good bowling from Riaz.
Low full toss outside off, Curran gets an outside edge which goes towards third man for a single.
On a length on off, Ali taps it to point and takes a single.
Tom Curran comes in.

OUT! RUN OUT! What an excellent piece of work from Wahab Riaz! Brilliant and saves a run for his side with that wicket as well. Good length ball on off, Jordan defends it to the off side and takes off for a single. Riaz comes charging ahead and collects the ball. He then turns and throws it to the bowler's end and hits. The third umpire is called for and the replays show that Jordan is well out. More important for England, Ali is on strike.
A run out appeal has been taken upstairs! Chris Jordan is the man in question. Let's see what happens.
WIDE! Full delivery down the leg side, Jordan looks to flick but misses. Wide given.

Good length ball outside off, Jordan looks to defend but it takes the outside edge and it goes towards the keeper. Ahmed dives to his right and makes a good half-stop as he saves it from going to a boundary. Only a single.
Chris Jordan comes into bat.

OUT! TIMBER! Pakistan needed that! This partnership was taking the game away from them Afridi gets them back into this game. Slower ball deceives Gregory there! It is bowled on middle, Gregory makes room and then looks to heave it away to the leg side. He is way too early into the shot and he misses and the ball goes to hit the stumps. 21 required from 13 balls.
Full ball on off, Ali lifts it towards long off where the ball falls short of the fielder. A single taken.
FOUR! So inventive from Ali! Afridi did not do anything wrong there but it was a terrific shot! Very full delivery outside off, Ali drives it to deep point for a boundary.
Slower delivery outside off, Ali looks to heave it away but misses.

EDGY FOUR! England will take the runs anyhow they come! Boundary off the first ball and this will release the pressure a little! Full delivery outside off, Ali looks to drive but it takes the outside edge and goes to the third man fence for a boundary.
Shaheen Afridi back on. He needs to bowl a very good over here.

FOUR! Smashed! This has turned out to be an excellent over for England! It started well for Pakistan but ends in England's over! Full on middle, Gregory thrashes it over the bowler's head for a boundary. 30 needed from 18 balls.
FOUR! A boundary was needed and a boundary it is! Full toss outside off, Gregory powers it over the mid off fielder for a boundary.
Very full ball on middle, Ali drives it to mid off for only a single.
Full toss on middle, Gregory works it to long on for a single.

FIFTY FOR MOEEN ALI! It has been an excellent innings and it has come in just 25 balls. He would know that the job is not done yet and needs to take his side home. Full delivery on middle, Ali clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
That was hit really hard! Short ball on middle, Gregory pulls it to deep mid-wicket and gives Ali the strike with a single.
Haris Rauf is coming into the attack. 2-0-19-0 are his figures.
On middle, Gregory flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single. Excellent over for England! 20 from it and they need 42 from 4 overs.
Full on middle, Moeen flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Moeen Ali is on fire! He is bringing England back into the game! This is brilliant! Short ball on middle, Ali comes down the track and pulls it over the deep mid-wicket region for a maximum.
Flatter and outside off, Ali looks to cut but misses.
SIX! BOOM! Brilliant! 12 from 2 balls! Floated outside off, Ali smashes it over long off for another biggie.
SIX! Excellent use of the feet! Just the start that England needed to the over! A googly on middle, Ali dances down the track and hammers it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Shadab Khan comes back on. 3-0-28-0 are his figures.
Just short! Short ball outside off, Ali guides it uppishly towards third man. It falls short and the batters pick up a single. 62 needed from the last 5 overs.
Good length ball on off, Lewis taps it to point and takes a single.
Back of a length ball on middle, Gregory defends it back to the bowler.
Slower ball on middle, Ali works it to short fine leg for a single.
Lewis Gregory comes into bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Riaz comes into the attack and picks up a wicket! This is an important wicket for Pakistan as Billings can be really dangerous. England still need 65 from 34 balls. Good length ball outside off, Billings looks to smack it over deep square leg but it takes the outside edge and goes towards third man where Imad Wasim takes a simple catch.
Slower ball on middle, Ali cannot do much as he defends it back to the bowler. Good start to the over.
Wahab Riaz returns to the attack.
Great finish to the over! Short ball around middle, Billings leaves it alone. 13 runs from it.
Good length ball on off, Billings looks to heave it but it takes the inside edge and it goes towards the leg side for a couple.
Slower delivery outside off, Billings looks to play it to the leg side but misses.
Very full delivery outside off, Ali drives it to deep cover and picks up a single.
SIX! That is beautiful batting from Ali! 10 off the first two deliveries! Full delivery on off, Ali powers it over long off for a biggie. 50-run partnership comes up.
FOUR! Good start to the over for England! Good length ball on middle, Ali hammers it wide of the long on fielder for a boundary. 75 needed from 41 balls.
Shaheen Afridi is back into the attack. 2-0-5-1 are his figures so far.
Full toss outside off, Sam drives it towards deep cover for a couple.
Yorker on middle, Billings digs it out back to the bowler.
Very full delivery way outside off, Sam leaves it alone.
Short ball outside off, Billings punches it wide of long off for a couple.
FOUR BYES! That has completely done the keeper! Full toss outside off, Billings looks to play the reverse sweep but misses. Sarfaraz also fails to collect and the ball races to the third man fence.
Very full outside off, Billings comes down and pushes it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Connects the reverse sweep this time. It is full and little too wide than the last ball, Moeen connects the shot this time and clears the short third man fielder and gets a boundary on the last ball.
Fires it full and outside off, Moeen looks to reverse sweep but makes no connection.
Short and outside off, punched wide of the deep cover fielder. A couple more for Moeen.
In the air... but short. Darts this outside off on a fuller length. Moeen reaches out and looks to clear long off but gets no timing on it at all. It lands well short of the fielder. Two taken.
Tossed up around off, Sam skips down the track and looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards the off side and they take a leg bye.
Full and around off, Billings looks to drill in on the leg side but ends up getting an inside edge on the pads.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Low full toss on middle, Ali drives it to long off for a single.

MISSED STUMPING! Sarfaraz Ahmed misses an easy stumping and Moeen Ali gets a life. Sarfaraz should have done better there! Wasim bowls a very full delivery outside off, Moeen looks to drive coming forward but misses. Sarfaraz fails to collect it cleanly in his gloves and that gives Moeen enough time to make it back. Moeen has to make Pakistan pay for this mistake.
Outside off, Sam punches it to extra cover and takes a single.
SIX! Excellent batting from Billings! England need much more of these! Tossed up on middle, Billings dances down the track and lifts it over the deep mid-wicket region for a maximum.
Short ball outside off, Billings comes down the track and pushes it to cover.
Good length ball outside off, Billings pushes it to cover and takes a single. 105 more runs to win.
FOUR! Brilliantly played! Short ball down the leg side, Billings just helps it on its way to the fine leg fence.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On a length on middle, Moeen flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Good length ball on off, Billings plays it to third man for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Ali guides it to third man for a single.
Wahab Riaz comes back on. 1-0-11-0, his figures so far.
FOUR! Pulled away nicely! Short one on middle, Billings pulls it to the deep square leg region for a boundary.
Flatter one outside off, Ali pushes it to deep cover for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Billings drives it to long on and takes another run.
Floats this one on off, Ali works it to square leg for a single.
Tossed up on off, Billings pushes it to the cover region for a single.
Loopy ball on middle, Ali flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Dot to end! Full and around off, Billings drives it well but straight to the cover fielder.
Sam Billings makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! LBW! Three reds it is and Banton has to go. An excellent review from Pakistan and they see the back of dangerous-looking Banton. Rauf with a brilliant ball. That was quick and came back in a hint from a good length. Banton looked to work it on the leg side but he was done with the pace there. He missed to make any connection and was hit on the pads, in front of the wicket. Rauf puts up a massive, massive appeal but the umpire says not out. Rauf is confident and Babar goes for the review. Time for the replays. The front foot is fine says the third umpire on air. No bat involved, confirms the Ultra Edge. Is it hitting the stumps? Yes, it is. So, Banton has to go. A very good innings from him but England needed a lot more from the right-hander. 121 more needed for England.
Pakistan have taken a review. It looks close. Let's see what happens.
Around off on a shortish length, Ali dabs it towards the off side for a run.
Good length ball on the pads, Banton looks to tuck it towards the leg side and but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards square leg and they take a leg bye.
Full and outside off, Moeen looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge. The ball goes to third man for a single.
Full and on middle. Banton flicks it towards long on for a run.
Moeen Ali is in.

OUT! RUN OUT! A big mix-up and the England skipper has to go! What a wicket for Pakistan! They know how important this wicket is and look at their reactions. They are over the moon! Flatter one outside off, Morgan cuts it towards cover and takes off for a single. Banton comes out of his crease but then sees the fielder collecting it and backs out. Morgan is already half-way down the pitch and has no way of making it back in as the fielder throws it to Sarfaraz Ahmed who does the rest. 126 more required from 78 balls.
SIX! That is a long, long hit! Flighted ball on middle, Morgan powers it over the deep mid-wicket region for a biggie.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Morgan looks to flick but misses. Wide signalled.
Short ball on middle, Banton pulls it to long on for a single.
Outside off, punched to cover.
Flatter one outside off, Banton punches it to deep cover and collects a couple.
Short one outside off, Morgan cuts it towards point for a single.
Shadab Khan comes on now.
FOUR! Banton continuing his on-slaught here! On a short length down leg, Banton slams this through the fine leg area for a boundary. The English Lions are at 54/2 a the end of the Powerplay.
Back of a good length around off, Morgan works this towards the third man region for a single.

Back of a good length outside off, Morgan smacks this on the up over the cover region and it goes up way into the deep blue hue of the Manchester sky before dropping into the grass. The batters get two runs.
NO BALL AND A FREE HIT! On a short length around middle and leg, Tom pulls this on the up towards deep square leg but it bounces just before the fielder at the deep and the batters get a single.
Short ball around middle and leg, Tom pulls this towards deep square leg and the batters will get two runs.
On a full length outside off, Banton shuffles across and tries to work this over the keeper's head but he misses this altogether.
Short delivery outside off, played to the fielder at point.
Wahab Riaz comes into the attack.
Nothing from the Free Hit! Good fielding! Good length ball on middle, Banton flicks it to square leg where the fielder makes a good stop. Just a single. Not the ideal start for Rauf. 16 runs from it.
FIVE NO BALLS! Poor stuff from Rauf! A waist-high full toss on the pads, Banton hops and flicks it to the deep square leg region for a boundary. A Free Hit will follow.
Full delivery on middle, Banton looks to heave it away but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
FOUR! Pulled away in disdain! Short ball on middle, Banton pulls it to the deep square leg region for a boundary.
Good length ball on middle, Banton defends it wide of the pitch. Morgan wants the single but is sent back by Banton. Rauf goes to collect the ball but clashes into Morgan who apologizes after that.
Short ball on middle, Banton pulls it to deep square leg for a couple.
FOUR! Excellent shot from Banton! He is looking good! Full delivery outside off, Banton leans forward and creams the drive through the cover region for a boundary.
Haris Rauf comes into the attack.
A single to end the successful over from Imad. Quicker one on middle, Banton flicks it towards long on for one.
Eoin Morgan, the skipper, comes out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! That's a brilliant catch in the deep. Malan falls as well. Tossed up ball around off and middle, Malan goes for the slog sweep and connects it well. It goes high in the air towards deep square leg. It looks like it might go over the fielder there but Fakhar keeps his eyes on the ball, times his jump to perfection and leaps to catch the ball and manages to maintain his balance well inside the rope.
FOUR! Drilled through the off side. Full and wide outside off, Malan strokes it through the off side and gets his first boundary.
Missed out! Short and on middle, Malan pulls but finds the man in the ring at mid-wicket.
Quicker one on the pads, worked towards the leg side for a quick run.
FOUR! Banton wants to take on Imad. He skips down the track and gets under the ball and smacks it over mid on for a boundary. Nice shot from him.
Dot to end! A terrific bouncer around off from Afridi. Malan does well to sway away from it. Just 2 from the over.

Quick single! Short and around off one more time, Banton once again fails to get on the top of the bounce and ends up mistiming the pull towards mid on. They go for the run. The fielder there misses his shy at the non-striker's end.
Another dot! Shortish and around off and middle, Tom mistimes his pull back to Afridi.
Beauty! That is a ripper! Just around off on a good length. It is meant to go away but as it comes closer, comes in a hint to beat the outside edge.

In the air... but drops well short. Good length ball just outside off, Malan looks to hammer it on the leg side but the ball takes thick outside edge and goes uppishly towards third man. It lands well short of the fielder there. Single taken.
Good length ball around off, pushed towards the off side.

FOUR! Boundary to end the over! Third from the over as Banton once again play the reverse sweep. This time he doesn't connect it well as it falls short of the short third man fielder who tries to lunge forward and catch. It bounces ahead and then evades the fielder and goes to the fence.
Quicker and flatter around off, Banton skips down the track and does well to block it out at the last moment.
FOUR! Two in two! And you can't set the field for this shot. He brings out the reverse sweep very early in the innings and clears the point fielder for another boundary.
FOUR! First boundary of the run chase. Very full and around off and middle, Banton skips down the track and drills it past the diving cover fielder.
Slower through the air and around off, pushed towards point.
Excellent start from Imad. Very full and around off, Banton can squeeze it back to Imad.
Imad Wasim is going to bowl from the other end.

Couple of runs to end the over! Good length ball outside off, Malan stays back and plays it past the backward point fielder. Before the third man can get around, he can scamper back for the second. Three runs and a wicket from the over.
Play and a miss! In the channel outside off, hint of away movement and that is enough to beat the outside edge.
Dawid Malan is coming into bat. Two slips in place.

OUT! TIMBER! That's a ripper from Afridi. A perfect yorker from him. Bairstow fails to put any bat on ball. It goes behind to rattle the base of the off pole. After seeing a couple of length balls, Jonny was probably waiting for another one as he stayed back. Bairstow departs for a 3-ball duck after a superb innings in the 2nd game. Excellent start for Pakistan.
Plays at this one and misses to connect. It is fuller and outside off, angled away. Bairstow looks to drive but misses.
Good length ball outside off, Bairstow watchfully lets it go behind.
The run chase is underway! Good length ball around middle, Banton tucks it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end. A hint of inswing there for Shaheen.
We are back for the chase! The Pakistan players make their way out to the middle, followed by Tom Banton and Jonny Bairstow. Shaheen Afridi will bowl for the visitors.
